method: node tools/globals.js --scan base-fold, then classify by signal per docs/globals-step2-plan.md

globals.evidence: Every user loads it then computes 351*i via lea/lea/shl/sub. Same chain at 0xe1ca5. Fields span 253 bytes, inside one 351-byte record.
Always [reg*4+0xce408]: mov/cmp/sub/add with a scaled index. Adjacent to 0xce488, which is the same table one field on.
Same four users as 0xce408 and the same [reg*4+addr] form, 0x80 bytes higher. A pair of parallel per-id tables.
All three users contain cli/out/in. 0xfec70 has pushfw, cli, in al,dx, out dx,al, popfw around the access. Not a game global.
Same three hardware routines as 0xdf0c7, used as a latch byte cleared to 0 between port writes.
mov dword [0xd6e60],0x30 initialises it; compared against 0 and decremented. No index chain, so it is a counter or mode word.

recovered_routines.diff: bytes 2..5 only, the displacement of mov dword [0xd6e60],0x30
